The test image shows **pods** - dark brown to almost black, shriveled pods with some orange-brown coloration and dark spots. Stem visible in background with reddish spots. No white mold visible.

Pod candidates: Anthracnose, Bean_Pod_Mottle_virus, Frogeye_leaf_spot, Green_stem_disorder, Phomopsis, Phytophthora, Purple_Seed_Stain, Tobacco_Streak_Virus, White_Mold.

The severe darkening and shriveling of pods points most to **Phomopsis** (cracked, shriveled, discolored pods) or **Anthracnose** (dark lesions with fruiting bodies). Let me check a Phomopsis reference.

The Phomopsis reference shows opened pods with gray mold on seeds inside - matching the pod decay pattern. The test image shows similar severely darkened, shriveling pods still closed but extensively discolored dark brown to black, consistent with Phomopsis pod and stem blight. The stem in the background also shows reddish-brown spotting.

Key evidence:
- Pods: severely darkened (dark brown to black), shriveled, collapsed appearance
- No white fluffy mold (rules out White_Mold)
- No purple/pink coloring (rules out Purple_Seed_Stain)
- Phomopsis causes pod decay with dark discoloration and seed shriveling
- The Phomopsis reference confirms this pod darkening/decay pattern
